security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline literals, example URLs, and fixed documentation links. Two command findings are confirmed because SKILL.md directs agents to run local Python helpers, and one network finding reflects intended page retrieval. User-controlled URLs lack visible private-network restrictions, so URL validation and structured command arguments are required.

remediation.issue: User-controlled URL retrieval lacks visible private-network restrictions.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only HTTP and HTTPS, resolve DNS, block non-public addresses, and repeat validation after every redirect.

remediation.issue: Helper command examples use unquoted URL placeholders.
remediation.suggestion: Invoke helpers with structured argument arrays, reject control characters, and pass only validated public URLs.

content.user_title: Audit On-Page SEO and Prioritize Fixes
content.value_statement: Weak page-level signals can reduce search visibility and make fixes difficult to prioritize. This skill scores controllable SEO elements and returns evidence-based actions.
actual_capabilities: Reviews titles, meta descriptions, headings, keyword placement, links, images, canonical tags, and visible schema signals.
Scores major audit areas and calculates an overall on-page SEO score.
Infers a provisional primary keyword when the user does not provide one.
Compares a page with competitor URLs when source content is available.
Groups larger URL sets into clusters and samples pages for pattern-level findings.
Produces P0, P1, and P2 recommendations with quick wins and a handoff summary.
limitations: It does not replace crawl, indexing, Core Web Vitals, or full technical SEO testing.
Keyword volume and Search Console metrics require connected tools or user-provided exports.
Raw HTML retrieval can miss schema and content inserted by client-side JavaScript.
Bulk conclusions are estimates based on sampled pages unless every URL is inspected.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Ranking Drop
use_cases.description: Audit one affected page, identify structural weaknesses, and rank fixes by likely impact.

use_cases.title: Review Content Before Publishing
use_cases.description: Check titles, headings, keyword placement, links, images, and metadata before release.

use_cases.title: Prioritize a Large Content Backlog
use_cases.description: Cluster many URLs, sample representative pages, and identify repeated template-level problems.

prompt_templates.title: Audit One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the on-page SEO of [URL] for [keyword]. Score each area, cite page evidence, and list the three highest-impact fixes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single public page

prompt_templates.title: Review Pasted Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this page content for [keyword]. Evaluate the title, meta description, headings, keyword use, links, images, and publish readiness.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review when a URL cannot be fetched

prompt_templates.title: Compare Competitors
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [my URL] with [competitor URL] for [keyword]. Explain score differences, missing coverage, internal-link gaps, and priority changes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a URL Portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Cluster these URLs by page type, sample representative pages, estimate repeated issues, state confidence, and produce a portfolio-level P0, P1, and P2 plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced bulk audit for five or more URLs

output_examples.input: A product guide has a long title, weak internal links, and three images without alt text.
output: P0: Add descriptive alt text to the three product images.
P1: Shorten the title and add four contextual internal links.

output_examples.input: A draft article has no supplied target keyword and contains a clear topic in its title and headings.
output: Estimated keyword: remote team onboarding checklist.
Status: Done with concerns until search demand is validated.
First fix: Align the title, H1, introduction, and two H2 sections with the inferred topic.

output_examples.input: A portfolio contains forty blog posts built from the same content template.
output: The pages are grouped into one primary blog cluster.
Three representative pages are sampled before estimating repeated issues.
Portfolio priorities separate template fixes from page-specific changes.

best_practices: Provide the page URL, target keyword, page type, and business goal.
Label every metric as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
Validate sampled findings before applying bulk changes across an entire site.
anti_patterns: Do not treat estimated keyword demand or competitor metrics as measured data.
Do not report missing JavaScript-injected schema from raw HTML without checking the rendered page.
Do not use this skill as a substitute for crawl, indexing, or Core Web Vitals analysis.

faq.question: Can this skill audit a page without a target keyword?
faq.answer: Yes. It can infer a provisional keyword from the title, headings, metadata, and opening content, then label the result as estimated.

faq.question: Can it audit private or unpublished content?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the HTML or page text when the URL is unavailable or access-controlled.

faq.question: Does it measure search volume?
faq.answer: No. Search volume requires a connected SEO tool, Search Console data, or a user-provided export.

faq.question: Does it check Core Web Vitals?
faq.answer: No. It may note visible page-level signals, but full performance and crawl analysis requires dedicated technical tools.

faq.question: Can it compare competitor pages?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide competitor URLs or content and a shared target keyword for a structured comparison.

faq.question: How does bulk audit mode work?
faq.answer: It clusters URLs by page type, samples representative pages, reports repeated patterns, and clearly labels extrapolated findings.
